name: SushiSwap
fix_description: In swapUniV3, the pool address is read from user-controlled stream data without verifying it was deployed by the canonical UniswapV3Factory. Attacker passes a malicious contract as pool, which calls uniswapV3SwapCallback and passes the msg.sender==lastCalledPool check, then steals tokens via safeTransferFrom. Fix: verify pool = UniswapV3Factory.getPool(token0, token1, fee) before calling swap.
difficulty_reasoning: No matching PoC file found for automated labeling.
